speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Friday is what I asked. You are a day early, if Thursday counts as early.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Friday is today enough. The pointing is in your hand. The spring note, as in the book. The winter note, as in the book. Do not better it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And Egeon. Thou openst the play, and then thou art idle till the end. I would not trade with thee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I open, and I wait. I am not asking any man to hand the part back.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I have the two birds. I will not copy a line onto a cleaner sheet to make them look new.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The lines stay in the book. The breath is where it was put on the twenty-first. You have the pointing, and that is the whole of the errand.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we are done until two. French Doctor is the Rose. We are not going. Thou at the start of Errors, and the rest of us earning the afternoon.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will hum nothing of theirs. I have an owl and a cuckoo, and they are enough for one morning.
